 Holika Festival 
 2027 festivals with dates but no tickets on sale: Holika, Brunch Electronik, Latin Fest and Tramunfest only open via registration or presale
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Pau 
 11 Nov 2026, 18:00 
 A 3-minute read 
 Brunch Electronik · courtesy of the organisers 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Holika has announced 1 to 4 July, but its pre-registration is already closed and its tickets page can only be opened with a password. 
 Brunch Electronik does let you sign up for the 2027 presale , from 6 to 8 August at the Parc del Fòrum, although it does not say when it opens or at what price. 
 Latin Fest has sales closed in Benidorm and in Valencia : pre-registration for the presale ended on 7 October and everyone else depends on the newsletter. 
 Tramunfest has already held its presale for past attendees on 10 November and has not set a date for general sale for its 2 and 3 July edition. 
 They have a date, a venue and a countdown on their websites, but no box office open to the general public. Holika , Brunch Electronik , Latin Fest and Tramunfest have set the dates for their 2027 editions and have left the first sale to prior registration or a restricted presale. This is what each official website says today and what can still be done.
 Festival guide 
 Holika Festival 2027 
 1–4 Jul 2027 · Calahorra 
 See festival guide 
 Holika: 1 to 4 July, with pre-registration closed
 The Holika website presents its 2027 edition as ‘Chapter IX – The Age of Gods’ with dates of 1 to 4 July , according to its own homepage. Early access to the presale depended on a free pre-registration that now displays a notice saying the form is closed. The tickets section, for its part, asks for a password to get in. There is no date or price for general sale.
 Brunch Electronik: 6, 7 and 8 August, with registration open
 Brunch Electronik is the only one of the four that still lets you sign up. Its website announces the edition from 6 to 8 August 2027 at the Parc del Fòrum in Barcelona and an ‘exclusive 2027 presale’ for registered users, with access to Early Bird tickets in ‘very limited quantities’. It does not say when it will open or how much they will cost.
 Latin Fest: Benidorm and Valencia, sales not yet available
 Latin Fest celebrates its tenth anniversary with two dates: 3 and 4 July at Benidorm Skyfest ( Latin Fest Benidorm profile ) and 17 July at the Estadi Ciutat de València , both from 18:00 to 02:30. Both pages on the website show ‘sale not available’ and that ticket sales are not yet open.
 Early access was for those who signed up in time. Pre-registration closed on 7 October at 23:59 , and the website states that those registered will receive notice of the presale. The graphic the festival used to announce it mentioned Benidorm passes from €34.90 in that presale. Those who did not register can only sign up to the newsletter to find out about general sale. No artists have yet been announced for either venue.
 The graphic Latin Fest used to announce pre-registration for the Benidorm presale. Image: Latin Fest Tramunfest: the presale has passed and general sale has no date
 Tramunfest , the techno and hard styles festival in Sant Jordi Desvalls (Girona), takes place on 2 and 3 July 2027 . Its first sale was a private presale for those who had already attended a previous edition, which opened on Tuesday 10 November at 18:00 via a link sent to the email address they had used to buy tickets at the time. The official shop lists €60 plus fees for Saturday, and the festival reminds fans that it only sells through its website and Enterticket. It has not announced when general sale begins.
 What you can do before sales open
 Today only Brunch Electronik is accepting new registrations. For the other three, the way forward is to sign up to each festival’s newsletter on its official website and use an email address you check, because the sale announcement will arrive there. A festival having a date but no sale does not guarantee that the first passes will last: several 2027 festivals have sold out batches before announcing a line-up, as we reported in the passes sold blind . The rest of the events in those months are in the July and August listings.
 Sources: official websites of Holika, Brunch Electronik, Latin Fest (homepage, Benidorm and Valencia pages and pre-registration) and Tramunfest, consulted on 11 November 2026; ModoFestival profiles of each festival.
